comment: Vercel reads whichever vercel.json sits at the project's Root Directory and ignores the other. This one is for a project rooted at the repo root; site/vercel.json is for one rooted at site/. They are kept equivalent on purpose, so the deploy is correct either way and setting the root directory is a preference rather than a repair.

headers.comment: Vite content-hashes these, so a change ships under a new filename and this can never go stale.
The fonts and the logo files keep their names, so they get a day rather than a year — swap a logo and it must not take twelve months to reach anyone.
